unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U11: Identify a subsisting legally recoverable debt and distinguish Tribunal officers

facts.statement: Section2(g) debt broad but subsisting/legally recoverable on application; prescribed business nexus; includes interest, assignments,decrees/awards and stated debt-security branch. Presiding Officer adjudicates,Recovery Officer executes certificate.

payload.title: Build the claim and its legal status together
payload.core_explanation_md:
A claimed balance is not established merely by copying an account number. The debt definition includes the described liabilities and interest, whether secured or unsecured, assigned or reflected in the specified decree/award routes, but requires the relevant business nexus and a subsisting, legally recoverable claim at application. Preserve the underlying documents, amount reconciliation and limitation analysis.

Keep the institutional roles distinct: the Presiding Officer determines the application and issues the stated recovery certificate; the Recovery Officer carries out recovery under the applicable powers. An execution officer is not a substitute forum for retrying every issue already determined in the certificate.

self_check.prompt_text: Does assignment alone extinguish the debtor obligation?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The claim transfer and legal recoverability must be analysed separately.

payload.stem_md: A bank produces a balance but no evidence that the claim is subsisting and legally recoverable on the application date. What remains necessary?

options.text_md: Only a new letterhead for the balance
options.explanation_md: Presentation does not establish legal recoverability.

options.text_md: An assumption that every recorded balance is recoverable forever
options.explanation_md: Limitation and substantive liability still matter.

options.text_md: Reconcile the underlying liability, documents and legal status at filing
options.explanation_md: The definition includes more than the presence of a ledger entry.

options.text_md: A declaration that unsecured debts are never debts
options.explanation_md: The source definition includes unsecured claims.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definition includes more than the presence of a ledger entry.

payload.stem_md: An execution note asks the Recovery Officer to decide the original liability afresh rather than execute or use the proper correction/appeal route. Which distinction matters?

options.text_md: Adjudication and certificate execution have different functions
options.explanation_md: The proper route depends on whether the issue concerns adjudication, correction or execution.

options.text_md: The Recovery Officer is the borrower accountant
options.explanation_md: That is not the statutory role.

options.text_md: Every execution objection automatically cancels the certificate
options.explanation_md: An objection is not an order setting it aside.

options.text_md: The certificate amount can be edited privately by the applicant
options.explanation_md: Private editing is not the statutory correction procedure.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The proper route depends on whether the issue concerns adjudication, correction or execution.
